title: "ダッシュボード"
subtitle: "Zotero の読書リスト（ローカル専用・公開されません）"
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<style>
.dash-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin: 1rem 0 1.4rem;
}
.dash-stat {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
}
.dash-stat:first-child { border-left: none; }
.dash-stat:hover { background: var(--code-bg); }
.dash-stat.active .dash-stat-num { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-stat-num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.dash-stat-label {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}
.dash-tagrow {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
}
.dash-tagchip {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0.32em 0.9em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.dash-tagchip:hover { color: var(--vermilion); border-color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-tagchip.active {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  border-color: var(--vermilion);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.dash-search {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  outline: none;
}
.dash-search:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-item {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 1.3rem 0;
}
.dash-star-btn {
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-right: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--vermilion);
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}
.dash-star-btn.off { color: var(--rule); }
.dash-star-btn:hover { opacity: 0.6; }
.dash-item-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}
.dash-item-title a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }
.dash-item-title a:hover { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-item-meta {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}
.dash-item-tags {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}
.dash-tag, button.dash-status, button.ai-toggle {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0.2em 0.7em;
}
button.dash-status { cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; }
button.dash-status:hover { opacity: 0.6; }
button.dash-status.st-to-read { color: var(--vermilion); border-color: var(--vermilion); }
button.dash-status.st-reading { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink-soft); }
button.dash-status.st-done    { color: var(--ink-faint); }
button.ai-toggle {
  font-weight: 600;
  border-style: dashed;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
button.ai-toggle:hover, button.ai-toggle.open {
  color: var(--vermilion);
  border-color: var(--vermilion);
}
.dash-ai {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.3rem;
  background: var(--code-bg);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--vermilion);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 2;
}
.dash-ai .lead { font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
.dash-ai p { margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
.dash-ai p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.dash-links {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-left: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.dash-links a, .dash-links button {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-left: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.dash-links a:hover, .dash-links button:hover { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-links a.draft, .dash-links button.pub { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-links button.del:hover { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-empty {
  border: 1px dashed var(--rule);
  padding: 1.6rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
</style>

<div id="dash-root"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const rootEl = document.getElementById("dash-root");
  const VAULT = "notes";
  const CONTROLLED_TAGS = ["理論", "構造推定", "因果推論", "Health"];
  const GEN_API = "http://localhost:4322";
  const SITE = "https://hasegawa-econ.github.io";

  const THEORY_TAGS = new Set(["理論", "情報設計", "意思決定", "意思決定論", "統計的意思決定論",
    "スコア", "ナラティブ", "アルゴリズム", "アリゴリズム", "AI", "最適停止", "ベイズ",
    "Information", "Infromation", "Informaiton", "Inforamtion", "情報"]);
  const CAUSAL_TAGS = new Set(["因果推論", "Cousal", "Causal", "ABテスト"]);
  const HEALTH_TAGS = new Set(["Health", "health", "ヘルス"]);

  async function get(path, base) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch((base || "") + path, { cache: "no-store" });
      return res.ok ? await res.json() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  async function post(path) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(GEN_API + path, { method: "POST" });
      return res.ok ? await res.json() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  const [data, shelf, aiListRaw, draftsRes] = await Promise.all([
    get("library.json"), get("shelf.json"), get("ai_list.json"),
    get("/drafts", GEN_API),
  ]);
  const aiList = new Set(aiListRaw || []);
  const draftSet = new Set((draftsRes && draftsRes.drafts) || []);
  const helperUp = !!draftsRes;

  if (!data) {
    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-empty">まだデータがありません。デスクトップの「研究ダッシュボード」' +
      'から起動すると、Zoteroの内容が自動で読み込まれます。</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Theoryツリー所属のitemID
  const cols = data.collections || {};
  function rootName(key) {
    const seen = new Set();
    while (key && !seen.has(key)) {
      seen.add(key);
      const c = cols[key];
      if (!c) return "";
      if (!c.parent) return c.name;
      key = c.parent;
    }
    return "";
  }
  const theoryIDs = new Set();
  for (const key of Object.keys(cols)) {
    if (rootName(key) === "Theory") {
      for (const iid of cols[key].items || []) theoryIDs.add(iid);
    }
  }

  const SHELF_MAP = { "未読": "to-read", "読中": "reading", "読書中": "reading", "読了": "done" };
  const API_STATUS = { "to-read": "未読", reading: "読中", done: "読了" };
  const LABEL = { "to-read": "未読", reading: "読書中", done: "読了" };
  const NEXT = { "to-read": "reading", reading: "done", done: "to-read" };
  const SKIP_TYPES = new Set(["attachment", "note", "annotation"]);

  const items = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items || [])
    .filter((it) => !SKIP_TYPES.has(it.itemType))
    .map((it) => {
      const tags = (it.tags || []).map((t) => (typeof t === "string" ? t : t.tag));
      const creators = it.creators
        ? it.creators.map((c) => c.lastName || c.name).filter(Boolean)
        : (it.author || []).map((a) => a.family || a.literal).filter(Boolean);
      const year =
        (it.date || "").match(/\d{4}/)?.[0] ||
        it.issued?.["date-parts"]?.[0]?.[0] || "";
      const ck = it.citationKey || it.id || "";
      const entry = shelf && shelf[ck];
      const status =
        (entry && SHELF_MAP[entry.status]) ||
        ["to-read", "reading", "done"].find((s) => tags.includes(s)) ||
        "to-read";
      let ctag = "未分類";
      if (tags.some((t) => HEALTH_TAGS.has(t))) ctag = "Health";
      else if (tags.includes("構造推定")) ctag = "構造推定";
      else if (tags.some((t) => CAUSAL_TAGS.has(t))) ctag = "因果推論";
      else if (tags.some((t) => THEORY_TAGS.has(t)) || theoryIDs.has(it.itemID)) ctag = "理論";
      const hasPDF = (it.attachments || []).some((a) => (a.path || "").endsWith(".pdf"));
      return {
        title: it.title || "(no title)",
        authors: creators.join(", "),
        year: String(year),
        venue: it.publicationTitle || it["container-title"] || "",
        tags: tags.filter((t) => !SHELF_MAP[t] && !["to-read", "reading", "done"].includes(t)),
        ctag, status,
        star: !!(entry && entry.star),
        hidden: !!(entry && entry.hidden),
        hasAI: aiList.has(ck),
        hasPDF,
        added: it.dateAdded || it.accessed || "",
        citekey: ck,
        url: it.url || it.URL || (it.DOI ? "https://doi.org/" + it.DOI : ""),
      };
    })
    .filter((i) => !i.hidden);

  items.sort((a, b) =>
    (b.star - a.star) || (b.added || "").localeCompare(a.added || ""));

  const STATUSES = [
    ["to-read", "未読"], ["reading", "読書中"], ["done", "読了"], ["all", "すべて"],
  ];
  let activeStatus = "to-read";
  let activeTag = null;
  let query = "";
  const openAI = new Set();
  const aiCache = {};
  const genState = {};
  const pubState = {};

  function count(s) {
    return s === "all" ? items.length : items.filter((i) => i.status === s).length;
  }
  function esc(t) {
    return String(t).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }
  function needHelper() {
    alert("この操作にはローカルヘルパーが必要です。デスクトップの「研究ダッシュボード」から開き直してください。");
  }

  function poll(kind, ck, onDone) {
    const path = kind === "gen" ? "/status?ck=" : "/pubstatus?ck=";
    const state = kind === "gen" ? genState : pubState;
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      const r = await get(path + encodeURIComponent(ck), GEN_API);
      if (!r) return;
      if (r.state === "done") {
        clearInterval(timer);
        delete state[ck];
        await onDone();
        render();
      } else if (r.state && r.state.startsWith("error")) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        state[ck] = r.state;
        render();
      }
    }, 4000);
  }

  function draftURI(i) {
    const file = "blog-drafts/" + i.ctag + "/" + (i.citekey || "無題");
    const body = [
      "---",
      'paper: "' + i.title.replace(/"/g, "'") + '"',
      "authors: " + i.authors,
      "year: " + i.year,
      "citekey: " + i.citekey,
      "tag: " + i.ctag,
      "status: draft",
      "---", "",
      "## 一言でいうと", "", "",
      "## 面白かったポイント", "", "",
      "## 自分の考え", "", "",
      "<!-- 書き終わったらClaudeに「書いた」と言うか、ダッシュボードの🚀公開ボタンで公開できます -->", "",
    ].join("\n");
    return "obsidian://new?vault=" + encodeURIComponent(VAULT) +
      "&file=" + encodeURIComponent(file) +
      "&content=" + encodeURIComponent(body);
  }

  function aiPanelHTML(ck) {
    const s = aiCache[ck];
    if (s === undefined) return '<div class="dash-ai">読み込み中…</div>';
    if (!s) return '<div class="dash-ai">要約を読み込めませんでした。</div>';
    const lead = s.for_public ? '<div class="lead">' + esc(s.for_public) + "</div>" : "";
    const body = (s.narrative || s.faithful?.abstract_ja || "")
      .split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean)
      .map((p) => "<p>" + esc(p).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>") + "</p>")
      .join("");
    return '<div class="dash-ai">' + lead + body + "</div>";
  }

  function render() {
    const visible = items.filter((i) => {
      const okStatus = activeStatus === "all" || i.status === activeStatus;
      const okTag = !activeTag || i.ctag === activeTag;
      const q = query.toLowerCase();
      return okStatus && okTag &&
        (!q || (i.title + " " + i.authors + " " + i.venue).toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });

    const stats = STATUSES.map(
      ([key, label]) =>
        '<div class="dash-stat' + (key === activeStatus ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-status="' + key + '">' +
        '<div class="dash-stat-num">' + count(key) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="dash-stat-label">' + label + "</div></div>"
    ).join("");

    const tagCounts = {};
    for (const i of items) tagCounts[i.ctag] = (tagCounts[i.ctag] || 0) + 1;
    const chips = [null, ...CONTROLLED_TAGS, "未分類"]
      .filter((t) => t === null || tagCounts[t])
      .map((t) =>
        '<span class="dash-tagchip' + (t === activeTag ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-tag="' + (t || "") + '">' +
        (t ? t + " " + tagCounts[t] : "すべて") + "</span>"
      ).join("");

    const list = visible.length
      ? visible.map((i) => {
          const ck = i.citekey;
          const meta = [i.authors, i.year, i.venue].filter(Boolean).join(" ・ ");
          const pdfLink = i.hasPDF
            ? '<a href="' + GEN_API + "/pdf?ck=" + esc(ck) + '" target="_blank">PDF</a>'
            : '<a href="zotero://select/items/@' + esc(ck) + '">Zotero</a>';
          const urlLink = i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">原文</a>' : "";
          const draftLink = '<a class="draft" href="' + draftURI(i) + '">✍ 下書き</a>';
          const ps = pubState[ck];
          const pubBtn = !draftSet.has(ck) ? ""
            : ps === "running" ? '<button class="pub" disabled>公開中…</button>'
            : '<button class="pub" data-ck="' + esc(ck) + '">🚀 公開</button>';
          const pubDone = ps === "done-shown"
            ? '<a href="' + SITE + "/blog/posts/" + esc(ck) + '/" target="_blank">公開済み ↗</a>' : "";
          const delBtn = '<button class="del" data-ck="' + esc(ck) + '" title="ダッシュボードから消す">× 消す</button>';
          const gs = genState[ck];
          const aiBtn = i.hasAI
            ? '<button class="ai-toggle' + (openAI.has(ck) ? " open" : "") +
              '" data-ck="' + esc(ck) + '">AI要約 ' + (openAI.has(ck) ? "▴" : "▾") + "</button>"
            : gs === "running"
            ? '<button class="ai-toggle open" disabled>生成中…</button>'
            : '<button class="ai-toggle gen" data-ck="' + esc(ck) + '">AI生成</button>';
          const errPanel = [gs, ps]
            .filter((s) => s && s.startsWith("error"))
            .map((s) => '<div class="dash-ai">' + esc(s.replace(/^error:\s*/, "")) + "</div>")
            .join("");
          const statusBtn =
            '<button class="dash-status st-' + i.status + '" data-ck="' + esc(ck) +
            '" title="クリックで 未読→読書中→読了 を切り替え">' + LABEL[i.status] + "</button>";
          const tags = statusBtn + aiBtn +
            i.tags.slice(0, 4).map((t) => '<span class="dash-tag">' + esc(t) + "</span>").join("");
          const starBtn =
            '<span class="dash-star-btn' + (i.star ? "" : " off") + '" data-ck="' + esc(ck) +
            '" title="★を切り替え">' + (i.star ? "★" : "☆") + "</span>";
          return (
            '<div class="dash-item">' +
            '<div class="dash-item-title">' + starBtn +
            (i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">' + esc(i.title) + "</a>" : esc(i.title)) +
            "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-meta">' + esc(meta) + "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-tags">' + tags +
            '<span class="dash-links">' + pdfLink + urlLink + draftLink + pubBtn + pubDone + delBtn +
            "</span></div>" + errPanel + (openAI.has(ck) ? aiPanelHTML(ck) : "") + "</div>"
          );
        }).join("")
      : '<div class="dash-empty">該当する論文はありません。</div>';

    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-stats">' + stats + "</div>" +
      '<div class="dash-tagrow">' + chips + "</div>" +
      '<input class="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="タイトル・著者・掲載誌で検索" value="' +
      esc(query) + '">' + list;

    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-stat").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", () => { activeStatus = el.dataset.status; render(); }));
    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-tagchip").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", () => { activeTag = el.dataset.tag || null; render(); }));

    // ステータス切り替え（未読→読書中→読了）
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("button.dash-status").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const i = items.find((x) => x.citekey === el.dataset.ck);
        if (!helperUp) { needHelper(); return; }
        const next = NEXT[i.status];
        const r = await post("/shelf?ck=" + encodeURIComponent(i.citekey) +
                             "&status=" + encodeURIComponent(API_STATUS[next]));
        if (r) { i.status = next; render(); } else needHelper();
      }));

    // ★
    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-star-btn").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const i = items.find((x) => x.citekey === el.dataset.ck);
        if (!helperUp) { needHelper(); return; }
        const r = await post("/star?ck=" + encodeURIComponent(i.citekey) +
                             "&on=" + (i.star ? "0" : "1"));
        if (r) { i.star = !i.star; render(); } else needHelper();
      }));

    // 消す（非表示。Zotero本体には残る）
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("button.del").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const ck = el.dataset.ck;
        const i = items.find((x) => x.citekey === ck);
        if (!helperUp) { needHelper(); return; }
        if (!confirm("「" + i.title.slice(0, 40) + "…」をダッシュボードから消しますか？\n（Zotero本体には残ります）")) return;
        const r = await post("/hide?ck=" + encodeURIComponent(ck));
        if (r) { items.splice(items.indexOf(i), 1); render(); } else needHelper();
      }));

    // AI生成
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("button.ai-toggle.gen").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const ck = el.dataset.ck;
        if (!helperUp) { needHelper(); return; }
        const r = await post("/generate?ck=" + encodeURIComponent(ck));
        if (!r) { needHelper(); return; }
        genState[ck] = "running";
        render();
        poll("gen", ck, async () => {
          const i = items.find((x) => x.citekey === ck);
          i.hasAI = true;
          aiCache[ck] = await get("ai/" + ck + ".json");
          openAI.add(ck);
        });
      }));

    // AI要約の開閉
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("button.ai-toggle:not(.gen)").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const ck = el.dataset.ck;
        if (!ck) return;
        if (openAI.has(ck)) { openAI.delete(ck); render(); return; }
        openAI.add(ck);
        render();
        if (aiCache[ck] === undefined) {
          aiCache[ck] = await get("ai/" + ck + ".json");
          render();
        }
      }));

    // 公開
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("button.pub").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const ck = el.dataset.ck;
        if (!helperUp) { needHelper(); return; }
        if (!confirm("下書きを本番ブログに公開します。よろしいですか？")) return;
        const r = await post("/publish?ck=" + encodeURIComponent(ck));
        if (!r) { needHelper(); return; }
        pubState[ck] = "running";
        render();
        poll("pub", ck, async () => { pubState[ck] = "done-shown"; });
      }));

    const search = rootEl.querySelector(".dash-search");
    search.addEventListener("input", (e) => { query = e.target.value; render(); });
  }

  render();
})();
</script>
```
